title: To establish a grant pilot program to provide child care services for the minor children of emergency services personnel to accommodate the shift work and nontraditional work hours of such personnel, and to enhance recruitment and retention of such personnel.
latestAction: Referred to the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure, and in addition to the Committee on Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
